# Stop paying per email. Run your own email platform
## Channel: Panara Studios
558 subscribers

### Description
66 views
Posted: 2026-09-30
opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server and sends through your own AWS account. Your domain, your data and your reputation stay yours.
Get it free: 

One command installs it on any server with Docker:
curl -fsSL  | sh

What you get:
• REST API and SDK, plus SMTP
• Domains with guided DKIM, SPF and DMARC setup
• Every email tracked, from sent to clicked
• Broadcasts, templates, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs
• No per-email pricing and no feature gates

Already on Resend? The API is compatible. Change two lines and keep your code.

Open source under Apache-2.0.

## Send like Resend.Own the stack.

A Resend-compatible API, AWS SES for delivery, and a dashboard on your server. One Docker Compose deploy.

### Send

REST API · SDKs

One POST sends an email. Point a Resend-style SDK at your opensend.cc URL. Keep your app code.

$ curl -X POST /emails{ "from": "you@yourdomain.com", … }→ 201 { "id": "em\_9f2…" }

### Deliver

### Logs and analytics

Every message, event and error is searchable. Bounces and complaints feed suppression automatically. Ships on Dashboard.

### Deliverability

Guided DKIM, SPF and DMARC on your domain. Your SES reputation stays yours. It is not shared with other customers. Ships on SMTP and Dashboard.

Keys that accept everything and deliver nothing. Wire up CI and staging without emailing real users. Ships on API and SMTP.
